final_answer:
Meta and Amazon both report on comparable fiscal-year (calendar year) bases, so the comparison is straightforward.

- Meta Platforms revenue: FY2023 $134,902M → FY2024 $164,501M, a growth of ~21.94% [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017]
- Amazon.com net sales: FY2023 $574,785M → FY2024 $637,959M, a growth of ~10.99% [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004]

Meta's revenue grew faster than Amazon's by approximately 10.95 percentage points (21.94% vs. 10.99%).

ANSWER: Meta grew faster, by approximately 10.9–11.0 percentage points (Meta ~21.9% vs. Amazon ~11.0%).
